description: This file defines the WorkflowService class which manages workflow scheduling, reminders, and related operations within a larger application. It includes methods for handling workflows triggered by form submissions, booking events, and lazy email reminders, utilizing external repositories, utilities, and enums.

classes.name: WorkflowService
classes.description: A service class providing static methods for managing workflows, scheduling reminders, and handling workflow-related events.

methods.name: getAllWorkflowsFromRoutingForm
methods.description: Retrieves all workflows associated with a specific routing form, considering organization context.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowRemindersOfRemovedTeam
methods.description: Deletes reminders associated with a team that has been removed or changed, updating related workflows.

methods.name: scheduleFormWorkflows
methods.description: Schedules workflows triggered by form submissions, including setting up reminders and delayed workflows.

methods.name: scheduleWorkflowsForNewBooking
methods.description: Schedules workflows related to new bookings, considering rescheduling, confirmation, and event type.

methods.name: scheduleWorkflowsFilteredByTriggerEvent
methods.description: Schedules workflows filtered by specific trigger events.

methods.name: scheduleLazyEmailWorkflow
methods.description: Schedules a lazy email reminder workflow based on event timing and workflow configuration.

methods.name: processWorkflowScheduledDate
methods.description: Calculates the scheduled date for a workflow based on event start/end times and trigger type.

methods.name: generateCommonScheduleFunctionParams
methods.description: Generates parameters for scheduling functions based on workflow and workflow step details.
